a.speaker: Monday, September 6, 2027
a.text:
Labor Day on Thimbleberry Court. Nine driveways, one long table, and a wind out of the east that smells faintly of somebody else's fire.

{partner.name} has a shift at the hill hospital tomorrow. {teen.name} is pretending not to watch the grill. {child.name} has the inhaler in a pocket, because the air index says Moderate and climbing. {dog.name} is under the table, waiting for a mistake.

Walk the court. Talk to your neighbors. Tap a person once to see them, twice to go to them.
